name: Ak1111
fix_description: In nonblockingLzReceive1, the function is public without verifying msg.sender is the LayerZero endpoint. It calls _creditTo which mints tokens to an arbitrary address. Anyone can call this to mint unlimited tokens. Fix: add require(msg.sender == address(lzEndpoint)) or use the standard LayerZero NonblockingLzApp pattern which restricts the caller.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a straightforward missing access control issue: the attacker directly calls an unrestricted mint-like function to create tokens, then swaps them for USDT in a single follow-up step. The PoC is very short, involves only one vulnerable contract plus a router swap, and requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning.
